cohort: The study included 7998 pregnancies in women over 18 years of age with congenital heart disease and 84,799 matched controls in Sweden, with data from 1973-2020.
finding: Women with congenital heart disease had an increased likelihood of giving birth prematurely by Cesarean section and having a small-for-gestational-age neonate compared to matched controls.
mod_finding: Women with congenital heart disease had an increased likelihood of delivery by Cesarean section compared to controls (OR 1.45, 95% CI 1.37-1.54).
